screen.travelstaff.nameless: Enter a name to use it
tooltip.travelstaff.travel_anchor_block: Look at this with a Staff of Traveling, or Teleportation enchantment to teleport.
tooltip.travelstaff.travel_staff: Sneak + Right-Click to short range Teleport. Look at Travel Anchor to warp.
enchantment.travelstaff.teleportation.de: Allows you to teleport as though holding a Staff of Traveling
enchantment.travelstaff.range.desc: Increases the distance you may teleport with a Staff of Traveling
config.travelstaff.title: Staff of Traveling Settings
config.travelstaff.world.closed: Open a world to edit its settings
config.travelstaff.isElevatorMode.help: Jump or sneak on an anchor to travel vertically. When off, aim at the destination anchor.
config.travelstaff.nameplateScale.help: Size of anchor names at all distances. Default: 70%.
config.travelstaff.maxTeleportDistance.h: Base anchor range in blocks, before the Range enchantment. Default: 64.
config.travelstaff.shortTeleportDistance: Free-blink range in blocks. The Range enchantment does not affect this. Default: 7.
config.travelstaff.staffCooldownTicks.he: Cooldown after a successful free blink, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). Default: 20.
config.travelstaff.rangeEnchantScaling.h: Extra anchor range per enchantment level: 0.5 means +50% per level. Default: 0.5.
config.travelstaff.maxAngle.help: Maximum aiming angle in degrees, from 0 to 180. Default: 30.
config.travelstaff.save.client_failed: Could not save personal settings. See the log.
config.travelstaff.save.world_failed: Personal settings saved; world settings could not be saved.
